Scope: 44 ready-built factories of 900 m² each in 11 blocks (B1–B11), with external utilities, roads, parking and street lighting.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours (225,761 man-hours in total). At the 03-Nov-2026 data date the project is 81.4% complete against 80.6% planned, 0.8% ahead. This week added 1.3% against 1.4% planned. Construction of the factory blocks remains 0.9% behind, and Blocks B4 and B5 are still about 21% and 20% behind their plan.

On plan overall, but almost no float is left at the finish. The P6 update finishes the project on 03-Mar-2027, three days before the contract completion date of 06-Mar-2027, with zero float on project completion. All 100 activities in progress are counted as behind schedule, and 229 activities have missed their start. Construction is 75.8% complete against 76.7% planned, and the civil works milestone slipped another week in P6, to 28-Nov-2026.

The weekly report and the P6 update use different baselines for the discipline milestones. For civil works the weekly report's baseline is 21-Feb-2027, while the P6 baseline is 01-Oct-2026 and the P6 forecast is now 28-Nov-2026, 58 days after its own baseline and one week later than last week. Mechanical works slipped six days to 27-Dec-2026. Electrical and architectural works stay at 02-Feb-2027, 43 days after their P6 baseline of 21-Dec-2026. The contractual milestone for site levelling, local roads and parking (P6 baseline 12-Feb-2026) has still not started and is again forecast for the data date itself.

Data notes

  • The weekly report workbook (WPR #37, .xlsb) has no text version in MD Files, so its figures were read from the original workbook in All Files. This week's values are the change from WPR #36 (27-Oct-2026, in the W05 folder).
  • The workbook's weekly columns do not match the change in its to-date figures: the report page gives 3,317 planned and 3,606 earned man-hours this week, while the to-date totals rose by 3,061 and 3,015. The to-date change is used here.
  • The block rows add up to 99,461 earned man-hours against a construction total of 108,367; the gap of 8,906 is consistent with Block B6 being under-recorded (437 of 11,824 man-hours, against 95.5% planned), unchanged since last week.
  • Testing and commissioning is still recorded at 40.6% earned against 13.6% planned, while the Testing sheet shows mechanical testing 8% complete and electrical and fire testing not started.
  • The report page's headline plan and earned values and the Risk & Issue log are cost-based; the log labels this cost-based figure as actual progress. This report uses the physical (man-hour) figures only.
  • The weekly report's general information gives a forecast completion of 06-Mar-2027 (no variance), while its milestone sheet and the P6 update give 03-Mar-2027. Its milestone baselines also differ from the P6 baseline (for example civil works 21-Feb-2027 against 01-Oct-2026).
  • The November manpower and equipment actuals (22 staff, 267 labourers, 20 items of equipment) repeat October's figures. The safety sheet gives 16,440 man-hours this week, the same as last week, but only 13,700 for the month to date.
  • Failed-start activities: this report gives 272 for last week, while last week's report gave 270.
  • The P6 file's project code is still DAM3-02-3 with a planned start of 14-Mar-2023, and the procurement sheets carry project ID DAM-05-009. The invoice summary still shows 0 submitted invoices although seven are listed.
  • The Risk & Issue log names Engr Hamdi as MODON PM; the weekly report names Engr. Affat Al-Enezi. Its dashboard shows 244 open risks and 128 open issues, against 5 open risks and no open issues in the logs.
  • No P6 PDF layout was uploaded this week; P6 dates come from the XER file. The photos have no date or GPS stamp.
